D: A Queensland mining engineer leads Australian tunnellers digging under enemy lines on the Western Front.
P: Serve the main when the tunnellers come up for air.
S: Golden oat and golden syrup biscuits, the biscuits that came in parcels from home. Mix 100g oats, 150g flour, 80g coconut and 120g brown sugar.
Corned beef and sweet pickle sandwiches, a Queensland lunch from home. Spread 8 slices of buttered bread with sweet pickle.
M: Crisp corned beef and potato hash topped with fried eggs. Boil 800g diced potatoes for 8 minutes and drain.
W: Thick slices of rich fruit cake with butter. Cut an 800g fruit cake into thick slices and serve with soft butter, the way it arrived in parcels for the troops.
K: Strong black tea with condensed milk. Brew 6 tea bags in 1.2L boiling water for 5 minutes.

s.how: Mix 100g oats, 150g flour, 80g coconut and 120g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, add 1 tsp bicarb in 2 tbsp boiling water and stir through. Roll balls and bake at 170C for 12 minutes.
Spread 8 slices of buttered bread with sweet pickle. Fill with 250g sliced corned beef and cut into triangles. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Boil 800g diced potatoes for 8 minutes and drain. Fry with a diced onion and 400g chopped corned beef until crisp. Top with 4 fried eggs.

w.how: Cut an 800g fruit cake into thick slices and serve with soft butter, the way it arrived in parcels for the troops. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Brew 6 tea bags in 1.2L boiling water for 5 minutes. Stir a spoon of condensed milk into each mug. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
